meta.author: Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj

title: Mā Muñcha Pañcha-daśakam
author: by Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj.
subtitle: Originally published in Śrī Gauḍīya Darśan, 12 January 1967

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
patitaṁ ghora-saṁsāre hy avaśaṁ prakṛter vaśat
translation: I have fallen into this terrible world and am helplessly subjugated by material nature. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
anādi-bhāgya-vaiguṇyāt bhoga-mugdhaṁ durāśayam
translation: Due to my ‘time-less’ misfortune, I have been bewildered by the wicked desire to selfishly enjoy. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
māyā-krīḍanakaṁ dīnaṁ nirālambaṁ nirāśrayam
translation: I am a toy of Māyā Devī. I am distressed. I have no support. I have no shelter. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
janma-mṛtyu-jarā-vyādhi-bhīti-chintāti-kātaram
translation: I am deeply troubled by birth, death, old age, disease, fear, and anxiety. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
jñānājñāna-kṛtānanta-pāpa-bhoga-bhayākulam
translation: I am overwhelmed with fear as I suffer the reactions for the unlimited sins I have knowingly and unknowingly committed. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
kāma-krodhādi-dasyubhir nirdayaṁ padamarditam
translation: I have been trampled by the feet of the merciless bandits – lust, anger, and so on. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
antaḥśatru-viparyastaṁ punaḥ punar vilañchhitam
translation: I am bewildered and harassed by internal enemies again and again. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
trāṇārthaṁ prārthyamāno ’pi na māṁ paśyati kaśchanaḥ
translation: Although I am praying for deliverance, no one sees me. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
pitaro bāndhavā devā asamarthāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ
translation: My ancestors, my friends, and the demigods are all incapable (of delivering me) and opposed to me. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
sva-para-bharasā-hīnaṁ nirupāyaṁ nirākṛtam
translation: I am devoid of any hope in myself and in others. I have no means whatsoever (of deliverance), and I am utterly spurned. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
mahāparādha-rāśi-nāmālayaṁ tyakta-sādhanam
translation: I am an abode of a profusion of terrible offences against the Name, and I have abandoned the way of deliverance. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
he sad-asad-vichārorddha-prapannārtiharo hare!
translation: O Lord! You remove the distress of the surrendered souls, who are beyond all consideration of good and bad. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
dāsatvaṁ dehi dāsānāṁ tava deva dayānidhe!
translation: O Lord! O Ocean of Mercy! Please give me the service of Your servants. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
niyuñkṣva nityadāsye māṁ pradāya prema-vartanam
translation: Please engage me in Your eternal service and grant me a salary of prema. O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha muñcha māṁ kṛṣṇa! dāsaṁ dīna-dayārṇava!
svāntaraṅga-sevāṁ dehi he gopījana-vallabha!
translation: Please bestow Your intimate service upon me, O Beloved of the gopīs! O Kṛṣṇa! O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed! Don’t abandon me. Deliver this servant.

text: mā muñcha-pañcha-daśakaṁ! kṛṣṇa dīna-dayārṇava!
tridaṇḍi-śrīdharodgītaṁ gṛhānedaṁ stavāmṛtam
translation: Tridaṇḍi Bhikṣu Śrī Śrīdhar sings aloud this Mā Muñcha Pañcha-Daśakam. O Ocean of Mercy for the distressed, Śrī Kṛṣṇa! Please accept this nectarean prayer.
